# Zander Martineau

> Personal site of Zander Martineau, a product engineer specialising in front-end web development, based in London, UK. Works on SEO, answer engine optimisation (AEO), generative engine optimisation (GEO), design systems, front-end engineering and iOS apps. Blog posts, worklog, code notes, projects, CV and more.

## Main pages
- [Work with me](https://zander.wtf/work-with-me/): front-end engineering, design systems, SEO, AEO, GEO and iOS development
- [About](https://zander.wtf/about/): who I am
- [Blog](https://zander.wtf/blog/): posts and worklog entries
- [Code notes](https://zander.wtf/notes/): short technical notes
- [Projects](https://zander.wtf/projects/): side projects and packages
- [CV](https://zander.wtf/cv/): work history
- [Now](https://zander.wtf/now/): what I am doing now
- [Uses](https://zander.wtf/uses/): my setup
